summary: Regression re-verification of RawPayloadCaptureInterceptor after hardening refactor (3 independent try/catch blocks, no Fault thrown; charset now honors message.get(Message.ENCODING) with UTF-8 fallback). Re-ran the existing JUnit test class with JDK 21 + Maven 3.9.9 and added ONE new hardening-focused test that feeds an InputStream throwing IOException on read; asserts handleMessage() degrades gracefully (no exception, RAW_XML_PAYLOAD stays null). Result: 5/5 tests pass, zero regressions. WARN log '[RAW-CAPTURE] Kon inbound stream niet cachen ... simulated read failure' confirms the new swallow-and-log branch is executed.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: three independent try/catch stages (copy+cache stream, extract-as-string, replace stream) each log WARN and continue; no Fault propagation - matches previous recommendation exactly.
Charset now correctly read from Message.ENCODING with UTF-8 fallback (also matches previous recommendation).
Minor nit (non-blocking): the third stage (message.setContent) is unlikely to ever throw in practice, but wrapping it in try/catch is defensive and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JDK 21 at /tmp/jdk-21.0.2 and Maven 3.9.9 at /tmp/apache-maven-3.9.9 still present (ephemeral, may need re-download in future sessions). Command: cd /app/ebms-adapter && mvn -pl ebms-orchestrator -am test -Dtest=RawPayloadCaptureInterceptorTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false. The -am flag is REQUIRED because ebms-orchestrator depends on ebms-common (which is not installed in local .m2 by default). Test file now contains 5 tests including the new IOException hardening scenario.
